title: Mercury Lounge
venue_description:
About Mercury Lounge

Founded in 2005 - Mercury Lounge is a converted gas station on the corner of 18th and Boston Avenue in Tulsa's vibrant midtown neighborhood. What started as a neighborhood dive bar has evolved into one of the most respected independent music venues in the region - earning recognition as Tulsa's Best Bar with the Best Bartenders.

Music Programming and Events

Mercury Lounge lives and breathes music - hosting live performances up to 7 nights a week. The venue regularly supports and showcases the best in live original music from local - regional - and national artists. Musical genres span the spectrum: alt - americana - bluegrass - red dirt - country - punk - funk - and rock. The legendary Bluegrass Brunch every Sunday at noon has become a cornerstone of Tulsa's music scene - featuring Johnny Mullenax Band and a rotating cast of the city's top musicians. Ticketed shows run most evenings - with house resident artists playing late shows on weekdays at no cover charge.

Venue Atmosphere and Amenities

The Mercury combines authentic dive bar character with excellent sound quality and professional production. The space features multiple areas including an open patio - covered patio with fireplace - pool table - and vintage jukebox. With a capacity of 150 - the intimate setting creates powerful connections between artists and audiences. The venue is proudly LGBTQIA affirming and maintains an 'everybody welcome' atmosphere. Happy hour specials run daily - with particularly popular events on Fridays and the must-attend Sunday brunch.

Community Impact

Mercury Lounge has served as a launchpad for numerous artists including the Turnpike Troubadours in the late 2000s. The venue continues to be a vital part of Tulsa's independent music ecosystem - providing a platform for emerging artists while hosting established touring acts. The space has become more than just a venue - it's a community gathering place where music lovers - musicians - and industry professionals connect over their shared passion for authentic - original music.

title: LowDown
venue_description:
About LowDown

LowDown is Tulsa's premier jazz club - located in the basement of the historic Archer Building at 108 N Detroit Avenue in the heart of the Tulsa Arts District. This contemporary live music venue and cocktail bar opened as the evolution of the beloved Duet Jazz Club - bringing world-class jazz programming to downtown Tulsa in an intimate speakeasy-style setting.

Music and Performance Programming

The venue hosts an impressive range of musical performances throughout the week - with shows typically Thursday through Saturday evenings. Programming includes touring jazz artists - local performers - comedy shows - and community jam sessions. The Free Energy all-ages jazz jam sessions happen on the 2nd and 4th Wednesdays of each month - hosted by The Mike Cameron Quartet. These unique events create rare collaborative opportunities between musicians of different generations and genres. Special annual events include the beloved Charlie Brown Christmas performances featuring Tulsa's finest jazz musicians bringing the Vince Guaraldi soundtrack to life. The venue has also hosted notable acts like Jacob Fred Jazz Odyssey - Chris Poppa Foster - and many acclaimed regional and national jazz artists.

Venue Features and Atmosphere

The intimate 140-seat listening room provides exceptional acoustics and a close connection between performers and audience. LowDown features a state-of-the-art sound system - considered among the best in Tulsa - along with professional stage lighting. The basement location below Duet restaurant creates an authentic speakeasy ambiance with sophisticated decor. Signature craft cocktails are available - though the venue operates without an in-house kitchen - instead partnering with local restaurants for food delivery via QR code. Entry is through Duet restaurant or via wheelchair-accessible elevator in the alley. Street parking is available on Archer and Detroit Avenues.

Commitment to Jazz Excellence

LowDown represents a vital part of Tulsa's jazz heritage - carrying forward the tradition of quality jazz performance in the city. The venue provides a professional platform for both established and emerging jazz artists - helping to grow Tulsa's reputation as a destination for jazz enthusiasts. The intimate setting allows audiences to experience jazz the way it was meant to be heard - up close and personal with exceptional sound quality. Through its diverse programming and welcoming atmosphere - LowDown serves as a cultural anchor in the Arts District.

title: Oklahoma Jazz Hall of Fame
venue_description:
About Oklahoma Jazz Hall of Fame

The Oklahoma Jazz Hall of Fame is a non-profit organization housed in the magnificent Art Deco Tulsa Union Depot - built in 1931. This historic building serves as the state's only facility devoted to honoring jazz - blues - and gospel musicians with Oklahoma ties. Founded by an act of State Congress in 1988 - the Hall of Fame relocated to the Depot in 2007 - bringing administrative and performance operations under one roof for the first time.

Mission and Heritage

The Hall of Fame's mission is to create unity through music while chronicling the history - evolution - and influence of jazz in Oklahoma. Tulsa has always been a nexus for musical influences in the state - making it an ideal hometown for this institution. The organization promotes the Kansas City style of jazz - which was shaped significantly through Oklahoma's jazz musicians - historic venues like Cain's Ballroom - and all-Black communities including Greenwood - Langston - Clearview - and Boley. Notable inductees include Chet Baker - Oscar Pettiford - Jimmy Rushing - Howard McGhee - Barney Kessel - Charlie Christian - Patti Page - and Jay McShann.

Regular Music Events

Every Tuesday from 6:00-10:00 PM - the Hall of Fame hosts free jazz and blues concerts that are open to the public. The format includes a jazz jam from 6:00-8:00 PM followed by a blues jam from 8:00-10:00 PM. These jam sessions represent one of the few open jam opportunities in the area where musicians and singers can showcase their talents. The sessions are remarkably open and welcoming - accepting all artists regardless of skill level - race - or gender. The level of musicianship is consistently high - the venue is friendly and casual - and the audience feels like an extended family. These living - breathing jam sessions honor how real jazz was born and developed. Admission is free - with donations accepted for drinks to support the Hall of Fame.

Facility and Museum

The facility includes museum exhibits displaying photographs - biographical information - artifacts - and memorabilia from legendary musicians. An on-site music library holds video - audio - and photographic materials about featured artists. The art gallery features sculptures depicting musical themes and performers. The large central space serves as both performance venue and gallery - with professional soundproofing and stage lighting. Free concerts are also offered during lunchtime on Thursdays and Fridays. The annual induction ceremony and concert - held each November - honors meaningful contributions to jazz - blues - and gospel music. The venue is increasingly popular for weddings and special events.

title: The Gathering Place
venue_description:
About The Gathering Place

The Gathering Place is a world-class 100-acre riverfront park along the Arkansas River in Tulsa. Opening in September 2018 - the park was built with a vision to create a welcoming natural space where members of Tulsa's diverse communities could come together to explore - learn - and play. Named Best City Park by USA Today - it has received multiple national and international awards and has been featured in National Geographic and The New York Times.

Music and Cultural Programming

The Gathering Place offers exceptional year-round programming that includes live music - artistic performances - and cultural events - all at no cost to visitors. The park hosts Pickin' in the Park - a family-friendly bluegrass acoustic jam session at Williams Lodge where musicians of all skill levels can bring their acoustic instruments and join in casual - no-pressure jam sessions featuring bluegrass - folk - jazz - and swing music. Concerts are held on the QuikTrip Great Lawn - bringing both local and touring acts to the community. The park also hosts the monthly First Friday Art Crawl events and partners with organizations like Taylor Entertainment Group for the Tulsa Jazz Fest.

Park Features and Attractions

The park offers amazing attractions for all ages including the Chapman Adventure Playground with larger-than-life features - Peggy's Pond with paddleboats from the ONEOK Boathouse - BMX and skate parks - beautiful gardens - and miles of trails connecting to the Midland Valley Trail and River Parks system. Free educational opportunities range from story time to art and musical programs. The park is committed to improving social - economic - and environmental sustainability in Tulsa while preserving and enhancing native ecosystems.

Community Impact

Since opening - The Gathering Place has become a cornerstone of the Tulsa community - serving as a symbol of a connected - diverse - and vibrant city. The park provides access to world-class amenities with no entry fee - ensuring all Tulsans and visitors can enjoy the space. Monthly events like First Friday often draw nearly 3000 people - making it a vital gathering place for the community. The park reflects the unique culture and spirit of Tulsa while continuing to inspire imagination and connection.
location: 2650 S John Williams Way - Tulsa - OK 74114

title: The Vanguard
venue_description:
About The Vanguard

The Vanguard is an intimate all-ages music and event venue located at 222 N Main Street in downtown Tulsa. The venue embodies the philosophy of experiencing artists in small - intimate settings before they achieve mainstream success - creating that special connection between performers and audiences that only happens in close quarters.

Music Programming

The Vanguard showcases frequent performances by emerging and independent artists across diverse genres. The venue hosts everything from rock and alternative to experimental and underground music. Shows run throughout the week with varying start times - typically in the evenings. The all-ages policy makes it accessible to younger music fans while maintaining a quality music experience for all attendees.

Venue Characteristics

The intimate venue provides excellent sightlines and sound quality - allowing audiences to experience performances up close. The space creates powerful connections between artists and fans in a way that larger venues cannot replicate. Located in downtown Tulsa - the venue is within walking distance of restaurants and bars for pre-show dining and drinks. The Vanguard represents the independent music scene in Tulsa - supporting touring artists and local performers alike.
